task.name: Independent development validation of a serial multi-segment soft arm
task.source: B1 v1 cold-start workspace coverage, frozen before dynamics search

environment.gravity_source: main@245a785 reach_free environment; Human-owned benchmark gravity

assumptions: SI; serial bending only; external frictionless straight tendon spans
One independent ideal tension per tendon; guide holes have fixed supplied inertia
Task environment owns mount and forces; assembly prototypes own connector, guide and payload
Clearance checks cover route stations and guide holes; swept self-collision is not validated
unsupported: polygon section domain not granted in this example
Dense structural-node layouts require separate numerical checks; a 22-coordinate zero-state CasADi dynamics solve failed despite a full-rank mass matrix

assumptions: SI; serial bending only; external frictionless straight tendon spans

source_provenance.ownership: Current contained research initial nominal; artifact read only, zero new scientific executions

provenance.reuse: Physical segment, connector, guide, payload prototypes only; source routes/actuators excluded; indexed segment IDs

unsupported: polygon section domain not granted in this example
Dense structural-node layouts require separate numerical checks; a 22-coordinate zero-state CasADi dynamics solve failed despite a full-rank mass matrix

context_guard.estimate: one token per serialized UTF-8 byte plus framing; conservative estimate, not tokenization

limitations: Best found signed J under the recorded algorithm, initialization and budget; no global nonlinear optimum.
Structural secants are finite-budget responses, not gradients or KKT/envelope derivatives.
Independent replay uses the same MuJoCo dynamics; no hardware, cross-model or other-controller transfer.
